positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Joined an early-stage team bringing Toast into a new product domain, contributing across platform development, infrastructure, and technical mentorship.
• Shipped hundreds of changes to the retail platform, consistently among the team's highest-output engineers.
• Integrated AI tooling into daily development workflows — code generation, testing, and debugging — and dedicated weekly time to evaluating new tools.
• Collaborated with principal engineers and technical design leads to design a scalable approach for extending Toast's partner-facing APIs with new data.
• Served as a go-to resource on infrastructure: taught teammates Toast's deployment processes, system architecture, and troubleshooting techniques.
• Led end-to-end delivery of a highly-requested feature built on asynchronous message handling to schedule and apply system data changes.
• Mentored junior engineers and supervised interns through onboarding and ongoing development.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Software engineer on Toast’s scale team, focusing on the organization’s API platform and infrastructure, API governance, and developer tooling.
• Built control-plane service in Kotlin that governs the routing behavior of hundreds of microservices
• Enhanced service deploy scripts, ensuring critical metadata preservation upon deployment
• Designed and built a file format validation plugin, wrote all code for the plugin, and distributed it to the teams that own the hundreds of microservices that now use it
• Made major updates to Kotlin code generation behavior
• Wrote a Gradle plugin to assist with usage of Toast's API schema database
• Created a scheduled task that monitors third parties' behavior through recurring API calls
• Helped build a gRPC service template and gRPC server and client educational materials (one developer described the gRPC template as "a dream to work with")
• Wrote thorough documentation about many tools owned and maintained by my team
• Continually addressed developers' support questions about gRPC, deploy processes, Java upgrades, and Toast's API standards

positions.title: Senior Manager of Developer Advocacy
positions.description:
Led Toast's developer relations team, which advises engineers at 150+ integration partners on how to build and maintain integrations with the Toast platform and advises more than a dozen R&D teams at Toast about the design and release of APIs.

TEAM MANAGEMENT:
• Built Toast’s developer relations team. Was once the sole developer relations employee and later built the role into a self-sustaining team with its own processes and thorough internal documentation.
• Managed a team of direct reports, provided team members with feedback, conducted recurring performance reviews, and helped team members learn, grow, and explore new opportunities.
• Wrote team career ladder to allow developer advocates to progress within their careers.

TECHNICAL AND PRODUCT WORK:
• Internal Toast point person for companywide API standard oversight. Collaborated with senior engineering team to create standards guide for Toast internal and external APIs and wrote the original draft of the guide. The API standards guide is now used by dozens of R&D teams across Toast.
• Escalation point person for integration technical emergencies.
• Toast internal expert on 16+ APIs. Designed and updated APIs alongside engineers and product managers and advised them on best practices for releasing this functionality to external organizations.
• Liaison to 150+ integration partners.
• Managed companywide Postman usage. Rolled out an updated Postman workspace strategy that affected 200+ Toast engineers across 36 teams and saved about 100 minutes per developer per week on API development and testing.
• Partnered with documentation team and wrote engineer-focused content in Toast's integration developer guide. Wrote 15+ integration development how-to guides, among many other documents.
• Key advisor to product manager for developer tools and the overall Toast integration developer experience.
• Developed API and front-end functionality updates in Java and Kotlin.

positions.title: Technical Coordinator
positions.description:
• Directed all hardware, printing, and technical aspects of an enterprise hospital’s implementation of Epic’s electronic medical record (EMR) system, resulting in a smooth technical go-live for 1600 concurrent users. Hospital departments that went live on this new EMR system included inpatient, emergency room, surgery, radiology, anesthesia, laboratory, registration, billing, and 50 outpatient clinics.
• Oversaw a team of 25 technical services staff. Reviewed technical support work, provided direct feedback to technical support staff members, and served as the Epic lead for managing escalated and high-urgency technical situations at the hospital.
• Coordinated projects integrating among leadership, technical, and application teams at the customer and at Epic, such as the testing of automatic printing processes at all 15+ hospital departments and 50+ clinics prior to the EMR go-live.
• Advised hospital C-level leadership on long-term technical vision.

positions.title: Technical Services Team Leader
positions.description:
• Managed a team of 4 direct reports. Ensured that team members provided high-quality support to Epic healthcare organizations and helped them grow and explore opportunities within the company.
• Worked with managers at team members’ 8 hospital customers to gather feedback and assess team member performance.
• Provided direct feedback to team members and conducted quarterly performance reviews.
• Oversaw team member workload and advised team staffing leads on technical support staffing decisions.
• Collaborated with other team leaders to coordinate projects, processes, and initiatives for 50-person technical support team.

positions.title: Technical Services
positions.description:
• Provided technical support to 5 healthcare organizations in professional billing (2012-2014) and home care and hospice (2014-2018).
• Debugged software code and diagnosed technical issues and opportunities for improvement.
• Worked with IT staff at healthcare organizations to build new healthcare workflows and optimize the system to meet their needs.
• Developed 52 custom programming solutions for customer requests.

honors.title: Toast Top Performers Award
honors.description: Awarded for high performance and consistently exceeding Toast’s expectations during 2020.

honors.title: Cooks in the Kitchen Award
honors.description: Awarded for a prompt response, technical thoroughness, and appropriate urgency when handling the resolution of a time-sensitive technical problem at a hospital.
honors.issuer: Issued by Management of Epic Home Health and Hospice Team · Aug 2017

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Big Brothers Big Sisters of America
volunteerExperiences.description:
Matched with little sister in 2014 when she was 8 years old. Get together with her once every 1-2 weeks to help her, mentor her, teach her, and have fun together.

The formal big sister match concluded after I moved from Madison, WI to Boston, MA in July 2018, but I continue to stay in contact with my little sister remotely.

company.name: Big Brothers Big Sisters of America

volunteerExperiences.description: Interview high school seniors about their interests, backgrounds, and educational goals in order to give the Rice admissions office a fuller picture of its applicants. Provide the Rice office of admissions with a comprehensive review of each student’s interview performance.

organizations.name: Will Rice Residential College at Rice University
organizations.position: Vice President (2011-2012); Events Committee Head (2009-2010); New Student Orientation Week Advisor (2010) · Aug 2008 - May 2012
organizations.description:
Vice President:
In charge of housing, parking, and the committee system of the 300-student college. Coordinated the room draw process and dealt with difficult housing issues, interviewed and selected committee heads to lead 16 committees, budgeted $10,000 toward capital improvements, and oversaw college activities throughout the year.

Events Committee Head:
Organized and executed college social events throughout the year (such as study breaks and a large carnival day), directed and produced a college talent show, managed a budget of about $4000.

New Student Orientation Week Advisor:
Helped eight new students acclimate to Rice University's culture and assisted them with academic planning and course selection. Was a resource to these students throughout the year and served as an upperclassman friend and mentor.
